complicacoes.texto: Doctor Luz receives gratification from the humiliation e suffering of others, especially women e those who are not consenting to his Vontade.

Doctor Luz’s Poderes require ambient Luz, suffering a Weakness effect in reduced Luz exposure. The Gamemaster determines the effect’s graduação, as suits lighting levels. The Poderes don’t work at all in Total Escuridão.
Doctor Luz can be driven into a rage if sufficiently mocked, belittled, or if his immense self-doubt is otherwise enflamed.
